name: Tile
description: List row for the React Native mobile app — leading visual (icon/flag/avatar), title + optional second line, and a reserved 30px trailing slot (none/chevron/check). selected = brand border + warm surface; onLayer="gray" drops the border.
notes: The `icon` slot doesn't force a tint color on native (RN has no CSS-style color inheritance to an arbitrary child) — same as Button's icon slot; pass an already-colored icon.
